## Who

Aditya Shaji. CS + AI/ML undergraduate at Atlas SkillTech University,
Mumbai, India (Aug 2025 - Aug 2029). Builds developer tools and local-first
AI runtimes. Currently founding Low End LLM.

## Experience

**Founder, Low End LLM** - Remote, Jul 2026 - Present
- Building an adaptive runtime to run quantized LLMs locally on 4GB-RAM
  laptops, for developers without high-end GPUs who want a real, local taste
  of tools like Claude Code and Codex.
- Shipped real-time RAM/CPU/battery profiling and a per-turn safety floor that
  halts inference before memory exhaustion.
- Integrating quantized model loading (GGUF via llama.cpp, Q4_K_M,
  mmap-based weight loading) and a pre-flight capacity check.

**Creator & Maintainer, Redis State Explorer** - Remote, Jun 2026 - Present
- VS Code extension that connects straight to Redis over the Engine API, with
  a live state panel and a diff timeline showing exactly which keys changed
  after a code save.
- 1,000+ downloads.
- Invited Reviewer, ISMIR 2026 (International Society for Music Information
  Retrieval).

## Projects

- **Docker Vitals** - Live Docker container monitoring inside VS Code.
  TypeScript, Docker Engine API, VS Code Extension API. Ships container
  start/stop events in real time rather than polling, plus a compose-diff that
  shows what changed the moment you save a docker-compose.yml or Dockerfile.
- **Redis State Explorer** - See which Redis keys changed, and when.
  1,000+ downloads.
- **Git Blend** - A commit's full diff, inline, the moment you hover a line.
  Positioned as a fast, free, zero-config alternative to heavier,
  subscription-gated blame views.
- **Low End LLM** - Adaptive runtime for quantized LLMs on 4GB-RAM laptops.
  Python, llama.cpp, GGUF, Q4_K_M.
- **AI Coding Assistant** - Built from scratch in Java with an autonomous
  agent loop for multi-step file read, write and run tasks. Java, OpenRouter API.
- **Pulsar Classification Model** - Calibrated Random Forest for pulsar
  detection on HTRU2 (~17,900 candidates, ~9% positive class). Probability
  calibration (Platt/isotonic) validated via reliability diagrams and Brier
  score; threshold from an explicit cost model rather than a default 0.5.
  ROC-AUC ~0.97, recall ~0.90 at precision ~0.90 on held-out test data.

  OpenRouter API, Docker Engine API, llama.cpp/GGUF

## How the site is built

One HTML file with the CSS inlined, plus js/data.js (all content) and
js/main.js (the terminal). No frameworks, no bundler, no analytics, no cookies,
no web fonts. Colour palette is Bliss green on near-black; the only surviving
Windows XP artefact is a decorative title bar. Minesweeper and Snake are
implemented in js/main.js and render directly into the output stream.
